item.text: {"answers":[{"question_id":"Q016_pdb_1acc_domain_split","answer":"In SCOP 1.75, PDB 1acc chain A was represented as a single SCOP domain, d1acca_ / SUNID 43828, with the description \"1acc A:\" and SCCS f.11.1.1: class f, Membrane and cell surface proteins and peptides; fold f.11, Anthrax protective antigen; superfamily f.11.1, Anthrax protective antigen; family f.11.1.1, Anthrax protective antigen. In current SCOPe 2.08 that whole-chain assignment has been refined into two classified evolutionary domains on the same chain: d1acca2 / SUNID 238522 covers 1acc A:14-225 and is the N-terminal PA14 module, b.179.1.1, in the All beta proteins class, Anthrax protective antigen N-terminal-like fold, PA14-like superfamily, PA14 family; d1acca1 / SUNID 238521 covers 1acc A:226-735 and is the C-terminal-like module, f.60.1.1, in the Membrane and cell surface proteins and peptides class, Anthrax protective antigen C-terminal-like fold, superfamily, and family. Thus the old f.11.1.1 entry should be read as a coarse historical whole-chain definition, not as evidence that residues 14-225 and 226-735 are one homologous unit. SCOPe 2.08 places the two pieces in different classes and different folds, and comparison of d1acca1 with d1acca2 finds no shared classified ancestor below the SCOP root. The change is exactly the case domains are meant to capture: one PDB chain and one toxin protein can be an assembly of separable evolutionary modules. Homology searches should therefore be run and interpreted by the SCOPe 2.08 domain boundaries: a hit to A:14-225 supports a PA14-like N-terminal beta-domain relationship, a hit to A:226-735 supports an anthrax-protective-antigen C-terminal-like relationship, and neither hit by itself establishes homology, fold, function, calcium binding, or a modeling template for the other region. Full-chain searches against 1accA can be dominated by the large 226-735 segment or can align a single module inside a multidomain chain, so remote searches and representative/template selection should split or mask the query at the refined boundaries and avoid transferring the obsolete SCOP 1.75 f.11.1.1 whole-chain assignment across the N-terminal PA14 domain.","evidence_used":["mcp__scope.get_scop_pdb_entry: /api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1acc; /api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1acc/chains; /api/v1/releases/1.75/pdb/1acc/domains; /api/v1/releases/current; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1acc; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1acc/chains; /api/v1/releases/2.08/pdb/1acc/domains","mcp__scope.get_scop_chain: /api/v1/releases/1.75/chains/1accA; /api/v1/releases/current; /api/v1/releases/2.08/chains/1accA","mcp__scope.get_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_; /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/parents; /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/annotations; /api/v1/releases/1.75/sids/d1acca_/homology; /api/v1/releases/current; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/homology","mcp__scope.compare_scop_domains: /api/v1/releases/current; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca1/homology; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/parents; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/annotations; /api/v1/releases/2.08/sids/d1acca2/homology"]}]}
